name: CoastGPT-Bench
description: A benchmark designed to evaluate LLMs on domain-specific coastal/science reasoning and knowledge tasks (multiple-choice and open-ended). It measures factual recall and applied reasoning in coastal science/engineering scenarios and policy-relevant questions to assess domain competency and instruction-following. Useful for testing models' performance on niche scientific knowledge and reasoning.
reputation: Community-contributed benchmark with limited but growing usage for domain-specific model evaluation.
